findings.detail: The live duplicate drill exposed loss of later run evidence. Updates now preserve the initial report and replace only the latest-attempt block.
Matching closed issues previously remained closed after a new real failure. They now reopen; diagnostic drills only update evidence.
The handler retains the first and latest run rather than an unlimited attempt history. GitHub Actions retains the other run records subject to repository retention.
